description.p: Those who die wishing for nothing but a chance to acquire more wealth become spirits of greed. In death, their state makes riches pointless but they crave them all the same. While channeling a spirit of greed, you gain the following abilities.
Spell List. While you are channeling a spirit of Greed, the following spells are considered spiritualist spells prepared by you.
Sense Greed. When you make a Wisdom (Insight) ability check to understand the object of someone’s envy, you can spend 1 ectoplasm point to gain advantage on that ability check.

Blood Money. When a creature within 60 feet of you dies, you can use your reaction and spend 1 ectoplasm point to turn their fleeing soul into stygian coins. When you do, you gain a number of stygian coins equal to the creature’s challenge rating or 1 (whichever is higher).

div.p: Stygian coins are made of a polished black reflective metal. On one side is a skull with a crown of flowers. On the other side is a wrought iron gate. To creatures who can’t see through illusions and are not spiritualists, each one looks identical to a gold piece.
